plugins.name: quest-tracker
plugins.description: An always-visible tracker of what you are actually doing: the main quest and its numbered steps, the tangents that do not block it, and the background work running without you, in a tmux pane.

plugins.name: phone
plugins.description: Detects when you are driving a session from your phone over Remote Control and adapts the replies accordingly. Switches itself on and off.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Blocks a long reply from ending without a TL;DR at the bottom.
